svg.title: Mahalanobis anomaly model: fitted covariance
svg.desc: The anomaly score is the Mahalanobis distance of a row from the centre of a multivariate normal fitted on the standardised scale. Each cell is the correlation of two variables in that fitted covariance: a row whose values break a strong correlation is far from the centre even when each value alone is ordinary.
svg.text: Correlation structure of the normal profile over 4 active variables
